issues.main_description_html:
Implementation: Modularize Functions Monolith Utility

Summary

Decomposed the monolithic src/Utils/Functions/Functions.go (~970 lines) into four domain-focused modules within package Functions. This achieves clear separation of concerns, improves maintainability and navigation, while preserving 100% backward compatibility for all existing callers across the repository.

Files Updated

1. New Modular Files Created in src/Utils/Functions/

  • src/Utils/Functions/crypto.go:
    • Implemented cryptographic encryption/decryption, AES/PBKDF2 algorithms, hashing, and token/slug generators:
      • GenerateRandomString, RandomBytes, RandomHex, Bin2hex, ConvertToMD5
      • EncryptResult, EncryptResponse, EncryptResultV1, KeyEncrypt, KeyEncryptV1, Decrypt
      • GenerateLegacySlug, GenerateJPEGFilename, GenerateUniqueSlug, StrShuffle
  • src/Utils/Functions/imaging.go:
    • Implemented image dimensions detection, MIME type checks, and attachment mappings:
      • IsJPEGOrPNG, AttachmentContentType, AttachmentExtension
      • GetImageSizeURL, DetectMimeType, GetImageDimensions, DetectMimeTypePath
  • src/Utils/Functions/response.go:
    • Implemented Fiber JSON error response formatting, error logging, and external HTTP request helpers:
      • ErrorResponse, ReCaptcha, ReCaptchaSlim, MakeGetCRULRequest
      • SaveLogErr, parseErrorLogUserID, CheckEncryptUser, ParseUUID
  • src/Utils/Functions/converter.go:
    • Implemented type conversion helpers, string casing, slice/map utilities, and base64 JSON handlers:
      • StoI, StoB, IsNumericString, atoi, Round
      • DecodeBase64JSON, EncodeBase64JSON, EpochTime
      • Ucwords, CapitalizeFirstLetter, Substr
      • InArray, Implode, MergeMaps, Chunk, Difference, HasValue, DeleteDirectory

2. Monolith File Removed

  • src/Utils/Functions/Functions.go: Deleted after clean distribution of all functions across the 4 modules.

Verification

go test -v -count=1 ./src/Utils/Functions/...
go test -count=1 ./src/Utils/... ./src/Action/... ./src/Worker/... ./cmd/... ./src/Config/... ./src/Routes/...
go build ./...

All 10 unit test suites in src/Utils/Functions/ passed without failure, all other package tests passed, and go build ./... compiled cleanly with zero errors.

Problem

The file src/Utils/Functions/Functions.go is a monolithic file (~970 lines) containing multiple unrelated responsibilities:

  1. Cryptography & Hashing: AES PBKDF2 encryption/decryption, MD5 hashing, legacy slugs, random byte/hex generation, and key calculation formulas.
  2. Imaging & Media: Image dimensions extraction, MIME type detection from header/path, attachment content type mappings, and image resizing helpers.
  3. HTTP, Error Response & Activity Logs: Fiber JSON error response formatter, ReCaptcha verification, error logging to PostgreSQL, and external HTTP request helpers.
  4. Data Conversion & String/Slice Utilities: String to int/bool converters, base64 JSON marshaling, epoch conversions, string title-casing (Ucwords), array chunking, map merging, and slice diffing.

This structure makes unit testing, code navigation, and maintenance difficult.

Scope

  • Modularize src/Utils/Functions/Functions.go by decomposing it into clean, domain-focused source files within package Functions:
    • src/Utils/Functions/crypto.go: Cryptography, hashing, keys, and slug/token generators.
    • src/Utils/Functions/imaging.go: Image dimension detection, MIME checking, and attachment utilities.
    • src/Utils/Functions/response.go: Fiber error responses, error logging, and HTTP/ReCaptcha helpers.
    • src/Utils/Functions/converter.go: Type casting, string casing, slice/map utilities, and base64 JSON helpers.
  • Retain exact function signatures, exports, and behaviors to maintain 100% backward compatibility across all callers.
  • Ensure all existing unit tests in src/Utils/Functions/ pass without modification.

Behavior Boundary

  • Does not change any function signature, return type, or algorithmic behavior.
  • Zero impact on external APIs or database schema.

Out of Scope

  • Refactoring business logic inside Actions or Controllers.
  • Auto-committing or pushing git changes.

Acceptance Criteria

  • src/Utils/Functions/Functions.go is safely replaced by modular files (crypto.go, imaging.go, response.go, converter.go).
  • All existing tests in src/Utils/Functions/ pass cleanly (go test -v ./src/Utils/Functions/...).
  • Whole repository test suite passes with zero regressions (go test -count=1 ./...).
  • go build ./... succeeds without errors.

Delivery

Implemented in the working tree on 2026-09-16. No commit was created.

issues.display_title: Issue #493: Consolidate Registration Handlers and Helpers
issues.main_description_html:
Implementation: Consolidate Registration Handlers and Helpers

Summary

Consolidated repetitive registration validation, OAuth token verification, user indexing, and JWT generation logic across all registration handlers (ValidateRegister.go, RegisterUser.go, RegisterGoogle.go, RegisterApple.go). The shared helpers were modularized into src/Utils/Functions/Registration/ with unit test coverage, reducing boilerplate by 579 lines across the handlers while preserving exact API contract behavior and fixing latent runtime panic risks in OAuth flows.

Files Updated

1. New Shared Utility Modules in src/Utils/Functions/Registration/

  • validation.go:
    • ValidateRegistrationEmail: Centralizes blacklist checks, forbidden character checks, and RFC mail parsing.
    • ValidateRegistrationUsername: Centralizes character regex matching, length checks (5–30 chars), and numeric-only rejection.
    • ValidateRegistrationFullname: Centralizes length and character validation for full names.
    • NormalizeOAuthUsername: Standardizes username derivation from email addresses for OAuth providers.
  • oauth.go:
    • VerifyGoogleToken: Safely verifies Google ID tokens via Google tokeninfo API without runtime panics.
    • VerifyAppleToken: Decodes Apple identity tokens, fetches Apple JWKs public keys, and verifies token kid.
    • OAuthSuccessResponse: Returns the standard JSON response envelope for OAuth authentication.
  • services.go:
    • GenerateUserEncrypt: Generates 8-character random encryption strings with DB uniqueness checking.
    • GenerateUserJWT: Builds and signs Hasura JWTs with admin and user roles.
    • GenerateRegisterJWT: Builds and signs registration-phase JWTs with userRegister role and expiration.
    • IndexUserElastic: Encapsulates user document indexing to ElasticSearch with default zero counts.

2. New Unit Tests in src/Utils/Functions/Registration/

  • validation_test.go: Unit tests covering valid/invalid cases for email, username, fullname, and OAuth username normalization.
  • oauth_test.go: Tests for OAuth response structure and token format validation.
  • services_test.go: Tests verifying proper Hasura claims and signature generation for user and registration JWTs.

3. Refactored Handlers in src/Action/V1/Register/

  • ValidateRegister.go:
    • Line count reduced from 308 to 158 lines.
    • Replaced inline Google/Apple verification and repeated email/username validation blocks with shared helpers.
  • RegisterUser.go:
    • Line count reduced from 458 to 290 lines.
    • Replaced repetitive validation, encryption key creation, ElasticSearch indexing, and JWT claims construction.
  • RegisterGoogle.go:
    • Line count reduced from 387 to 244 lines.
    • Eliminated panic(err) and log.Fatalf in favor of safe error propagation.
    • Extracted avatar download, MinIO upload, and ImgProxy signing into private helper processOAuthAvatar.
  • RegisterApple.go:
    • Line count reduced from 292 to 143 lines.
    • Replaced ~90 lines of inline Apple JWK decoding and key matching with RegisterFunctions.VerifyAppleToken.

Verification

go test -v ./src/Utils/Functions/Registration/...
go test -v ./src/Utils/Functions/...
go build ./...
  • All unit tests in src/Utils/Functions/Registration/ passed.
  • All unit tests in src/Utils/Functions/ passed.
  • Entire codebase compiled cleanly with go build ./... (0 errors).

Problem

The registration handlers in src/Action/V1/Register/ (RegisterUser.go, RegisterGoogle.go, RegisterApple.go, and ValidateRegister.go) contained significant boilerplate duplication and inconsistent error handling:

  1. Validation Duplication: Email validation (blacklist, illegal characters, RFC parsing) and username constraints (character patterns, length bounds, numeric checks) were repeated across multiple handlers.
  2. OAuth Token Verification: Apple token decoding, JWK public key fetching, and verification were duplicated across ValidateRegister.go and RegisterApple.go (~90 lines duplicated). Google token verification in RegisterGoogle.go used panic(err) and log.Fatalf on network or image failures, risking server goroutine panics.
  3. User Initialization Boilerplate: Generating unique encryption keys, creating Hasura JWT claims, and indexing new user documents in ElasticSearch were duplicated across all registration endpoints.
  4. Code Navigation & Maintenance: High line count (over 1,400 lines across the 4 handlers) made code navigation and maintenance cumbersome.

Scope

  • Extract shared registration utilities into package RegisterFunctions (src/Utils/Functions/Registration/):
    • validation.go: Centralized email, username, and fullname validators, plus OAuth username normalization.
    • oauth.go: Safe Google ID token verification, Apple JWK identity token verification, and OAuth response envelopes.
    • services.go: Unique user encrypt generator, Hasura user/register JWT claims generators, and ElasticSearch user indexing.
  • Add comprehensive unit tests in src/Utils/Functions/Registration/:
    • validation_test.go
    • oauth_test.go
    • services_test.go
  • Refactor src/Action/V1/Register/:
    • ValidateRegister.go: Streamline type checking and validation using shared helpers.
    • RegisterUser.go: Use shared validators, encryption generator, ElasticSearch indexer, and JWT builders.
    • RegisterGoogle.go: Eliminate panic(err) and log.Fatalf, extract avatar processing, and adopt shared utilities.
    • RegisterApple.go: Eliminate duplicated Apple JWK verification and adopt shared utilities.
  • Retain clear, uppercase step comments (// COMMENT) inside handlers and function headers (// ===================================//) for code readability.

Behavior Boundary

  • 100% backward compatible: preserves exact HTTP status codes, error codes, response payloads, database records, and RabbitMQ events.
  • Replaces runtime panics and process exits in OAuth token/avatar handling with proper Fiber error responses.

Out of Scope

  • Changing authentication API route signatures or database schemas.
  • Modifying email templates or RabbitMQ worker consumers.

Acceptance Criteria

  • All duplicate registration logic consolidated into reusable helpers under src/Utils/Functions/Registration/.
  • Unit tests added with all tests passing cleanly (go test -v ./src/Utils/Functions/Registration/...).
  • Handlers in src/Action/V1/Register/ successfully refactored and readable.
  • go build ./... compiles cleanly with zero errors.

Delivery

Implemented in the working tree on 2026-09-17.

issues.display_title: Issue #494: Consolidate Auth Login Handlers and Helpers
issues.main_description_html:
Implementation: Consolidate Auth Login Handlers and Helpers

Summary

Centralized duplicate authentication and session maintenance logic across all login handlers (Login.go, LoginGoogle.go, LoginApple.go, and KeycloakHandlers.go). Introduced helpers.go in src/Action/V1/Auth/ alongside unit tests in helpers_test.go, reducing code across the handlers by 368 net lines (+87 / -455) while removing runtime panic vulnerabilities in Google token verification.

Files Updated

1. New Helper Module and Tests in src/Action/V1/Auth/

  • helpers.go:
    • ReactivateUserIfRequested: Handles account deletion cancellation, user reactivation in DB, and Redis cache invalidation.
    • RefreshUserSession: Updates last_login timestamp and refreshes Redis user details cache.
    • BuildLoginResponse: Builds standard login response JSON map with user details and completion flags.
    • RespondLogin: Dispatches either encrypted or plain JSON based on the ec parameter.
    • LinkGoThruAccount: Links GoThru account to the user if absent, and appends email/encrypt to response.
    • OnboardingCompleted: Reads boolean onboarding_completed flag safely from map.
  • helpers_test.go:
    • TestOnboardingCompleted: Tests all truthy, falsy, missing, and nil map conditions.
    • TestBuildLoginResponse: Validates the structure and flags of the login response envelope.
    • TestReactivateUserIfRequestedEmptyReturnsFalse: Tests fast path when no deletion request exists.

2. Refactored Handlers in src/Action/V1/Auth/

  • Login.go:
    • Line count reduced from 267 to 198 lines.
    • Replaced manual user reactivation, session refreshing, JWT creation, and GoThru linking with shared helpers.
  • LoginGoogle.go:
    • Line count reduced from 208 to 134 lines.
    • Replaced panic(err) with safe RegisterFunctions.VerifyGoogleToken.
    • Replaced repetitive session refresh, reactivation, JWT generation, and response construction.
  • LoginApple.go:
    • Line count reduced from 309 to 157 lines (almost 50% reduction).
    • Replaced ~85 lines of duplicate Apple JWK parsing and key fetching with RegisterFunctions.VerifyAppleToken.
    • Streamlined both LoginApple and LoginAppleAfterRegister.
  • KeycloakHandlers.go:
    • Line count reduced by 85 lines.
    • Replaced inline user reactivation and session refresh.
    • Simplified indexKeycloakUser to delegate directly to RegisterFunctions.IndexUserElastic.
    • Removed 9 unused imports.

Verification

go test -v ./src/Action/V1/Auth/...
go test -v ./src/Utils/Functions/Registration/...
go test -v ./src/Utils/Functions/...
go build ./...
  • All 18 tests in src/Action/V1/Auth/ passed.
  • All unit tests in src/Utils/Functions/Registration/ and src/Utils/Functions/ passed.
  • Entire repository compiled cleanly with go build ./... (0 errors).

Problem

The login handlers in src/Action/V1/Auth/ (Login.go, LoginGoogle.go, LoginApple.go, and KeycloakHandlers.go) exhibited heavy repetition of core authentication logic:

  1. User Deactivation Recovery: Logic checking for pending user deletion (users_request_delete_id), removing the deletion record, setting is_active and is_back to true, and clearing deactivation cache on Redis was copied across 4 different handlers.
  2. Session and Cache Updates: Updating last_login via UserFunctions.UpdateLastLogin and refreshing Redis user details cache were duplicated in every login flow.
  3. JWT Claims Construction: Generating Hasura JWT claims (admin, user, and x-hasura-user-id) and signing with HS256 was repeated across Login.go, LoginGoogle.go, LoginApple.go, and KeycloakHandlers.go.
  4. OAuth Token Verification Duplication: LoginApple.go contained ~85 lines of duplicate Apple JWK decoding and key matching, identical to what was previously in registration. LoginGoogle.go contained unhandled panic(err) on Google token verification.
  5. Response Construction & Encryption: The standard login response map and optional response encryption (ec=true) were copy-pasted across all handlers.
  6. GoThru Account Linking: Identical GoThru linking logic was present in both Login.go and LoginGoogle.go.

Scope

  • Create centralized authentication helpers in src/Action/V1/Auth/helpers.go:
    • ReactivateUserIfRequested: Encapsulates checking and restoring deactivated accounts.
    • RefreshUserSession: Encapsulates updating last_login and updating Redis user details.
    • BuildLoginResponse: Standardizes the response envelope for successful logins.
    • RespondLogin: Standardizes optional encrypted vs plain JSON responses.
    • LinkGoThruAccount: Encapsulates GoThru account creation and response enrichment.
    • OnboardingCompleted: Reusable helper to read user onboarding status.
  • Add unit tests in src/Action/V1/Auth/helpers_test.go:
    • Testing OnboardingCompleted, BuildLoginResponse, and ReactivateUserIfRequested.
  • Refactor src/Action/V1/Auth/:
    • Login.go: Use shared helpers, reducing file size and removing unused imports.
    • LoginGoogle.go: Eliminate panic(err) using RegisterFunctions.VerifyGoogleToken, and adopt shared helpers.
    • LoginApple.go: Eliminate ~85 lines of manual Apple JWK decoding using RegisterFunctions.VerifyAppleToken, and adopt shared helpers.
    • KeycloakHandlers.go: Delegate user reactivation, session refresh, and ElasticSearch indexing to shared helpers.
  • Maintain consistent comments: top-level headers (// ===================================//) and concise uppercase step comments (// COMMENT).

Behavior Boundary

  • 100% backward compatible: maintains exact JSON response structures, status codes, JWT claims, Redis keys, and DB queries.
  • Replaces runtime panics during Google OAuth login with graceful error responses.

Out of Scope

  • Modifying authentication routes, middleware, or Keycloak SSO server configurations.

Acceptance Criteria

  • Shared auth helper module implemented with unit tests.
  • Login.go, LoginGoogle.go, LoginApple.go, and KeycloakHandlers.go refactored and deduplicated.
  • All unit tests pass cleanly (go test ./src/Action/V1/Auth/...).
  • Project builds with zero errors (go build ./...).

Delivery

Implemented in the working tree on 2026-09-17.

Implementation: Modularize Redis Utility

Summary

Decomposed the monolithic src/Utils/Redis/Redis.go (576 lines) into five domain-focused modules within package Redis. Each file now has a clear and isolated responsibility (client, user cache, post cache, panorama/worker status, and analytics rollup), while preserving 100% backward compatibility for all callers across the codebase.

Files Updated

1. New Modular Files in src/Utils/Redis/

  • client.go (45 lines):
    • RedisClient: Global Redis client instance.
    • InitRedis: Initializes the Redis client from environment variables.
    • redisCtx: Helper creating context with a 3-second timeout.
    • scanKeys: Non-blocking cursor-based key scanning helper.
  • user_cache.go (170 lines):
    • ReplaceUserDetails: Fetches, formats, and caches active user details with 1-day TTL.
    • ReplaceDeactiveUser: Queries and caches the list of deactivated user encrypts.
    • SuggestionUser: Generates and caches full and partial user suggestion lists.
    • ListBlockUser: Queries and caches blocked users for a given user.
  • post_cache.go (130 lines):
    • ListBookmarksUser: Retrieves and caches user bookmark post slugs with 24-hour TTL.
    • ReplaceBlockedPostEC: Caches blocked post slugs excluding deactivated users.
    • ReplaceEmbedPost: Queries and caches embed post listings (tourmkr, villume, video, gvt).
    • ListEmbedPost: Retrieves embed posts from Redis cache, falling back to database query if absent.
  • panorama_cache.go (125 lines):
    • SetPanoramaStatus, GetPanoramaStatus, DeletePanoramaStatus: Manages per-panorama file status.
    • GetRequeueStatus, IncrementRequeueStatus, DeleteRequeueStatus, InitializeRequeueStatus: Manages worker retry/requeue counters.
    • DeleteAllPanoramaStatus: Uses scanKeys to delete all status keys for a given SID.
  • api_hits.go (77 lines):
    • RollupAPIHits: Background task rolling up hourly API hit counters with distributed Redis locking.

2. Unit Tests Created

  • client_test.go:
    • TestRedisCtx: Verifies context creation, non-nil deadline, and cancel behavior.
    • TestRedisCtxRespectsTimeout: Verifies context timeout propagation.

3. Monolith File Removed

  • src/Utils/Redis/Redis.go: Deleted after distribution into domain modules.

Verification

go test -v ./src/Utils/Redis/...
go test -v ./src/Action/V1/Auth/...
go test -v ./src/Utils/Functions/...
go build ./...
  • All unit tests in src/Utils/Redis/ passed cleanly.
  • All other test suites passed.
  • Entire repository compiled cleanly with go build ./... (0 errors).

Problem

The utility file src/Utils/Redis/Redis.go was a monolithic file (~576 lines) handling multiple disconnected cache domains and background tasks in a single file:

  1. Redis Client & Connection: Client initialization, timeout context helper, and non-blocking key scanning.
  2. User Cache: User details caching, deactive user lists, user suggestions, and blocked users caching.
  3. Post & Bookmark Cache: User bookmarks mapping, blocked posts per user, and embed posts caching/retrieval.
  4. Panorama & Worker Status: Panorama upload/processing status, worker requeue counter increments, and bulk key cleanup.
  5. API Hits Analytics: Background hourly rollup job (RollupAPIHits) using distributed Redis lock, aggregation, and archival list storage.

This monolithic layout made maintenance, testing, and domain isolation difficult.

Scope

  • Modularize src/Utils/Redis/Redis.go into domain-specific modules within package Redis:
    • client.go: Redis client initialization, context timeout management, and non-blocking key scanner.
    • user_cache.go: User details cache, deactivated user list cache, suggestions generator, and blocked users cache.
    • post_cache.go: Bookmark mappings, blocked post EC list, and embed posts cache/retrieval.
    • panorama_cache.go: Panorama status cache, worker requeue counter, and batch deletion by SID.
    • api_hits.go: Hourly API hits aggregation background job with distributed locking.
  • Remove monolithic src/Utils/Redis/Redis.go.
  • Retain all exported functions, variables, and behavior for 100% backward compatibility.
  • Add unit tests for core helpers in src/Utils/Redis/client_test.go.

Behavior Boundary

  • 100% backward compatible: maintains exact Redis key naming conventions, TTL expiration rules, data formats (base64 JSON), and database queries.
  • Zero breaking changes to external callers.

Out of Scope

  • Changing Redis key schema or TTL policies.
  • Modifying Redis configuration parameters in .env.

Acceptance Criteria

  • Monolith Redis.go decomposed into focused modules (client.go, user_cache.go, post_cache.go, panorama_cache.go, api_hits.go).
  • Unit tests added and passing cleanly (go test -v ./src/Utils/Redis/...).
  • Whole repository builds cleanly (go build ./...).

Delivery

issues.display_title: Issue #497: Consolidate OTP and Password Recovery Flow
issues.main_description_html:
Implementation: Consolidate OTP and Password Recovery Flow

Summary

Centralized repetitive logic across the OTP and password recovery flows (CheckOtp.go, ResendOtp.go, OtpDelete.go, ForgotPassword.go, ResetPassword.go, UpdatePassword.go). Introduced otp_helpers.go in src/Action/V1/Users/ along with unit tests in otp_helpers_test.go, streamlining OTP lifecycle management, email queue notifications, captcha verification, and role-scoped JWT creation.

Files Updated

1. New Shared Helpers and Tests in src/Action/V1/Users/

  • otp_helpers.go:
    • VerifyCaptcha: Dispatches to ReCaptcha or ReCaptchaSlim based on request query.
    • UpsertUserOtp: Standardizes querying, inserting, or updating records in the otps table.
    • SendOtpQueueEmail: Assembles standard OTP email payloads and publishes them to RabbitMQ.
    • GenerateHasuraRoleJWT: Builds and signs Hasura JWTs with custom roles (userForgotPassword, userRegister).
    • UpdateUserPasswordAndCache: Hashes passwords, updates database records, and syncs Redis user details.
  • otp_helpers_test.go:
    • TestGenerateHasuraRoleJWT: Verifies claim structure, roles, and subject encoding.
    • TestVerifyCaptchaEmptyTokenReturnsFalse: Validates rejection of empty tokens in captcha checks.

2. Refactored Handlers in src/Action/V1/Users/

  • CheckOtp.go: Streamlined user JWT generation using RegisterFunctions.GenerateUserJWT. Preserved exact encrypted and unencrypted response structures.
  • ResendOtp.go: Adopted VerifyCaptcha, UpsertUserOtp, SendOtpQueueEmail, and RegisterFunctions.GenerateRegisterJWT. Strictly preserved response structure (no extraneous fields added) and slim encrypted format.
  • OtpDelete.go: Adopted UpsertUserOtp and SendOtpQueueEmail.
  • ForgotPassword.go: Adopted VerifyCaptcha, UpsertUserOtp, GenerateHasuraRoleJWT, and SendOtpQueueEmail. Strictly preserved exact response map and slim encryption behavior.
  • ResetPassword.go: Adopted UpdateUserPasswordAndCache.
  • UpdatePassword.go: Adopted UpdateUserPasswordAndCache.

Verification

go test -v ./src/Action/V1/Users/...
go test -v ./src/Action/V1/Auth/...
go test -v ./src/Utils/Functions/...
go build ./...
  • All unit tests in src/Action/V1/Users/ passed cleanly.
  • All unit tests in Auth, Registration, Functions, PostFunctions, and Redis passed.
  • Entire repository compiled cleanly with go build ./... (0 errors).

Problem

The OTP verification and password recovery endpoints in src/Action/V1/Users/ (CheckOtp.go, ResendOtp.go, OtpDelete.go, ForgotPassword.go, ResetPassword.go, and UpdatePassword.go) contained scattered and repeated boilerplate:

  1. Captcha Verification: Checking standard vs slim ReCaptcha (ReCaptcha vs ReCaptchaSlim) was repeated across multiple handlers.
  2. OTP Record Lifecycle: Querying existing OTP records, calculating expiration timestamps, and performing upsert operations into the otps table was duplicated across ResendOtp.go, OtpDelete.go, and ForgotPassword.go.
  3. Queue Notification: Constructing RabbitMQ JSON payloads for OTP email templates (email_verified, email_forgot, email_delete_account) and logging queue publish failures was duplicated.
  4. Scoped Hasura JWT Creation: Generating role-specific Hasura JWTs (e.g. userForgotPassword, userRegister) with expirations was repeated.
  5. Password Updating & Cache Refresh: Hashing password with MD5, updating database records, and invalidating Redis user details was duplicated across password reset and update actions.

Scope

  • Introduce shared helper functions in src/Action/V1/Users/otp_helpers.go:
    • VerifyCaptcha: Encapsulates standard vs slim ReCaptcha validation.
    • UpsertUserOtp: Standardizes checking, inserting, or updating user OTP records.
    • SendOtpQueueEmail: Standardizes assembling and publishing OTP emails to RabbitMQ with error logging.
    • GenerateHasuraRoleJWT: Encapsulates role-scoped Hasura JWT generation with expiration.
    • UpdateUserPasswordAndCache: Standardizes password hashing, database update, and Redis user details invalidation.
  • Add unit tests in src/Action/V1/Users/otp_helpers_test.go.
  • Refactor handlers:
    • CheckOtp.go: Use shared GenerateUserJWT from RegisterFunctions.
    • ResendOtp.go: Adopt shared captcha verification, OTP upsert, RabbitMQ publish, and JWT builder.
    • OtpDelete.go: Adopt shared OTP upsert and RabbitMQ email publisher.
    • ForgotPassword.go: Adopt shared captcha, OTP upsert, RabbitMQ publisher, and role JWT builder.
    • ResetPassword.go & UpdatePassword.go: Adopt UpdateUserPasswordAndCache.
  • Retain uppercase step comments (// COMMENT) and clean function headers (// ===================================//).

Behavior Boundary

  • 100% backward compatible: maintains exact status codes, error payloads, RabbitMQ message formats, OTP types, and database state transitions.
  • Strictly preserves all JSON and encrypted response structures (including sl=true and ec=true slim flows) without modifying or injecting any extra fields, guaranteeing zero breaking changes for mobile and frontend clients.
  • Zero impact on external APIs or database schema.

Out of Scope

  • Changing email template content in consumers.
  • Modifying OTP expiration durations (15 minutes).

Acceptance Criteria

  • Shared helpers created with unit test coverage.
  • Handlers in src/Action/V1/Users/ refactored and deduplicated.
  • All unit tests pass cleanly (go test ./src/Action/V1/Users/...).
  • Project builds cleanly (go build ./...).
